notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 timestamped Send Directed Interaction and timestamped Receive Directed Interaction surfaces to the official C++ declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. The linked Catch2 scenarios cover lower-bound validation, known-target/declaration routing, constrained-recipient queueing before the grant, timestamp/order/retraction callback fields, pending-fanout suppression, and a legal Request Retraction callback for an already-delivered nonconstrained directed recipient. The shared directed-recipient planner honors the by-ownership versus universal selector; current timestamped cases use a universal subscription but do not independently characterize the full selector matrix. Directed DDM, alternate advance modes, save/restore, remote transport, packaging, catalog evidence, and conformance remain outside this slice.
